    envelope (nominal 13.14 mm, AG105_Silvertel.pdf Figure 11) (T-A-08).
47. **MS2, enclosure and chassis (r7):** lid clearance over the footprint and both tabs, chassis room past the MB +y edge
    for the EVM plate (88.90 x 88.90 mm EVM + clamps + the J8 mating gap) and past the MB -x edge, the MB mounting scheme,
    chassis clearance under the MB for the 22 tails, and the Teensy USB plug length and bend room. It decides the EVM plate
    position and the W-lead route maxima (H.23(l)); until then every W lead keeps the 0.30 m cap (T-A-02).
48. **MS3, unrecorded MB items (r7; gate for PM0):** position and height of the OPA197 5 V bodge wire, the 10 kOhm EN bodge
    resistors, the 74HC14, the 2026-08-16 encoder reroute wires, R171 on C-D2 pad 1 and RENC2 inside each tab outline
    + 0.5 mm and under each foot spot; the L-FC body by caliper. It decides the tab outlines (T-A-08).
49. **MS4, LM1084 thermal survey (r7):** MB surface temperature at 1, 5 and 10 mm from the 5V copper rim into tab X. It
    decides the thermal-band split; the estimate is a 3.3-17.0 C rise at 5 mm (H.23(h)), and the F101/R172 derating at
    CO-5V pad 1 uses the same reading (T-A-05).
50. **MS5, vibration (r7):** MB acceleration near the CHG footprint in a representative run, peak shock and spectrum
    0.1-8 kHz. It decides whether the feet suffice; the H.23(i) first-mode figures are order-of-magnitude upper estimates,
    and T-F-18 confirms after the build.
51. **MS6, thicknesses (r7):** MB thickness at the CHG holes, CR finished thickness and laminate modulus. It decides the
    post arithmetic (CR-top protrusion 0.940 mm at 1.6 / 1.6 mm), the foot height (h_f 2.24 mm) and the first-mode
    estimates (H.23(i), H.23(j)).
52. **MS7, EVM as received (r7):** thickness, as-built outline, mass, tail protrusion and the heights of J7, J8, J9, the
    jumper headers with shunts and the test points. It decides the clamp design and the plate clearances.
53. **MS8, fab rules (r7):** the fab 1.6 mm 4-layer stack-up, L4 tenting, minimum inside-corner router radius and the 2 oz
    outer minimum space at the U101 0.5 mm pitch. It decides the PM0 DFM check (copper weight) and the three concave
    tab-root corners (H.23(a)).

    on its stock bumpons, no fastener or adhesive bonds EVM copper to the plate, the CR or the chassis, and T-A-02 checks the
    insulation (> 1 MOhm).
55. **Foot bond on polyimide (r7):** the FT1/FT2 beds bond neutral-cure RTV to the polyimide sheet without primer, which no
    datasheet in the library confirms (TODO(verify: RTV datasheet)); the bed stiffness rests on E_RTV 1-3 MPa assumed
    (14-128 N/mm under FT1, 36-320 N/mm under FT2, H.23(i)). T-A-09 decides; the fallback is a sheet cut-out with the bed on

    lies 0.862 mm from the tab Y top edge (1.012 mm at the silkscreen, H.23(b)). TODO(verify: Eaton HCM1A1305V3 drawing);
